newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pioneer sees lower full year profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pioneer sees lower full year profit.

text.p: Building products and petrolum group Pioneer International Ltd said on Wednesday it expected a materially lower profit in the year to June 30, 1997.

"Our current outlook for the second half of the year is for a slightly lower profit than the first half -- the net profit for the fully 1996/97 year is likely to be materially lower than for the previous year," Pioneer said in a statement accompanying its first half results.
Pioneer earlier reported a 18.3 percent fall in net profit to A$112.7 million for the six months to December 31.

Pioneer said the contribition in the second half from the group's worldwide building materials operations was expected to be at least equal to the corresponding period last year, but the contribution from its 50 percent owned petroleum refining and marketing group Ampol would be significantly lower.

"Ampol's profit performance represents the major uncertainty in the outlook," the company said. "Overall, group earnings before interest and tax from building materials are expected to be lower for the second half compared with the first half."
